en: Historic black‑and‑white postcard view of a cobblestone street lined with multi‑story townhouses and shops. Horse‑drawn carriages and pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing move along a gently rising street. Business signs such as "Hotel Kaiser Friedrich" and "Georg Taut" are visible on the buildings. The caption at the top reads "Torgau a. d. Elbe. Breitestrasse." and a printer's mark and year appear at the bottom.
